About

I'm Haimo Duan.

Senior integrated marketing, sponsorship and communications leader with 15+ years driving brand strategy, partnership growth, and large-scale campaign delivery for premium global brands and government entities. Deep specialism in automotive (Lamborghini, Bentley, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, WEY), sponsorship/partnership management, and international sports & cultural platforms, built over a decade at Ogilvy plus senior leadership roles in the UAE.

Skilled at translating brand strategy into 360° campaigns, sponsor activation, and cross-border stakeholder management across Greater China, the Middle East, Europe and more regions. Haimo also runs her own women's sports community, encouraging women to build physical and mental wellbeing and confidence through sport.

Brand strategy & architecture
